title: finding: required-context registry pins Build Docs and Console Pin Gate, absent from the maintainer's 2026-08-18 six-item required-set reading
body:
## Observation

`scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` REQUIRED_CONTEXTS registers `Build Docs` (ci.yml:build-docs) and `Console Pin Gate` (ci.yml:console-pin), both authorized "#5617 closing ruling 2026-08-09, second batch". The maintainer's own reading of the required set (2026-08-18, recorded verbatim on #9325 comment 5323233615: 「目前 Status checks that are required」 followed by exactly six contexts) lists `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Build Core`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, `Lint & Repo Gates` — and neither `Build Docs` nor `Console Pin Gate`.

## Why it is worth one maintainer look

Per the registry's own doctrine a row whose context left the Settings is "merely inert, never wrong" — the pin "this job still has this name" holds either way. But a stale row invites exactly the collision class that cost #9495 a full pre-flight stop-and-report cycle the same day: a later retirement/rename card contradicted by a screenshot-era `authorized` line, resolvable only by a maintainer reading Settings. Two readings are possible and only the maintainer can tell them apart:

- the two contexts were removed from the ruleset some time after 2026-08-09 — then the rows should either drop (the #6865 two-step: attest, then registry follows) or carry a dated note saying they are knowingly inert;
- the 2026-08-18 six-item reading was partial — then the registry is right and the recorded attestation under-lists, which is worth correcting where it is recorded.

Either answer is a one-look reconciliation; no code path changes. (No agent seat can read Settings/Rulesets — HTTP 403, per the script header's #6865 measurement.)

Cross-links: the attested six-item reading is quoted in #9495's premise-resolution comment; the registry row removal precedent (tombstone note + RETIRED_CONTEXT_NAMES row) is in PR #9523.
